history: Three-dot diff from each pinned merge base to its own head, including nonmerged branches. Attribute new historical call/expected-scalar examples only to the PRs introducing them relative to their base. Track every changed path and touched Python tests.
training: Stages in PR number order; no PR number, filename, test name, expected output or split enters features. A shared hidden layer and all active heads updated on retained training examples, with equal weight per task. Compare the first and final held-out performance and scores after every stage.
history_split: SHA256 of canonical serialized arguments modulo five; bucket zero is evaluation, others training. Split independent of PR number and task. Ambiguous labels excluded. Static public test expectations are retrospective diagnostics.
sources: Named source datasets retain their original splits; public historical probes use their own separate lane. Drop from training any text occurring in any evaluation partition across curated tasks. Parent representations may already have seen historical probes.
features: signed character 1/2/3-grams and word features; append activations of published V13 modular parent and its trained comparison head for genuinely marked adjacent same-carrier contrasts only, and ordered representations of exactly readable words from the NTP recursive checkpoint. Preserve missing channels.
assessment: For each task count final held-out correct, total, balanced recall, initial prediction, majority from training; require two trained and tested labels and strict improvement in both exact count and balanced recall over both controls to count a bounded learned outcome. A full-PR claim additionally requires exhaustive declared outcome coverage; framework/CI and proof changes are separate obligations.
acceptance: Unknown or untested outcomes block a universal claim. Do not equate tests, ancestors, scores copied from old reports, ancestry, or issuing a receipt with acquired behavior.
masked_public_contract: Retrospective, separate source-code question lane: compare scalar or boolean result predicted from the relevant setup and assertion expression after removing the asserted answer and all prior assertions. Drop literal answer echoes. Group entire original test method across PRs before splitting; drop train text that also occurs in any holdout. This measures predicting authored contract answers from code, never natural-language ability or passing the complete underlying contract.
extra_sources: Historical PR 101 split by factor, PR 134 by event fixture, PR 142 tests the conditional-to-factual combination against the other three. PR 143 uses four fresh historical NTP replays, partitioned by term before label comparison.
